name: Cheesy Pepperoni Crescent Rolls with "Pizza" Dipping Sauce (Cooking with Kids)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved if you feel comfortable. Have fun!
Preheat oven to 375°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with cooking spray.
Place egg in a small bowl, whisk to combine, and set aside.
Open the crescent roll package and unroll the dough onto a flat surface. Separate into 8 triangles along the perforated lines.
Divide pepperoni between triangles, arranging in an overlapping row on the base of each triangle. Top with cheese, then working from the base, roll the pastry around the pepperoni and cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
85 g pepperoni
¾ cup shredded cheese, pizza blend

instructions.primary_message: Arrange pizza rolls on the baking sheet, spacing them at least 1-inch apart. Brush with egg wash and sprinkle with Italian seasoning.
Place pizza rolls in the oven and bake until golden and cheese is melted, about 12 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place pizza sauce in a small saucepan and set over medium heat. Bring to a simmer, stirring occasionally. Once simmering, remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
Divide crescent rolls between plates and serve with warm pizza sauce for dipping. Enjoy!
